children: CEO Sam Altman is expected to call for a U.S.-led international coalition when he briefs the United Nations Security Council on Wednesday in New York City, according to reports.
"Sam Altman will brief an open UN Security Council meeting in person ​next week," said an

spokesperson. "His remarks are ​expected to focus on the steps OpenAI is taking to ensure AI ‌is ⁠safe and benefits people globally, along with the need for international coordination and shared safety standards."

The meeting takes place after AI company executives called for a deliberate pacing of AI model development due to its ever-increasing capabilities, particularly in the cybersecurity space. The U.N. Security Council first addressed the potential risks of AI during a 2023 meeting.
It will be a busy week for Altman, who is also expected to
the Trump-Xi state dinner with OpenAI President Greg Brockman and other high-level tech executives on Thursday.

title: OpenAI's Altman to call for US-led global AI standards at UN General Assembly: report
